messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to deploy redwood-infer:v3.4.1 at 22:00 UTC. Will toggle feature flag ff/llm-routing-v3 to enable for 0→5% canary, then 20% after 10m if metrics look good. Can we confirm deploy-bot and oncall coverage?

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @maya for 2026-03-23T22:00:00Z. Artifact: redwood-infer:v3.4.1. Canary cohort: 5%. Auto-rollback: enabled. Health checks: token-latency P95 < 1200ms, error-rate < 0.5% over 2m. Will post status updates here.

jonathan: Oncall window ok — I'm monitoring from 21:30-23:30 UTC. I'll watch traces and p95. Please add me to the alert list.

sasha: I updated the rollout notes and pinned model routing to v3.4.1 in config. Snippet for ops: 
```
feature_flag: ff/llm-routing-v3
initial: 0.05
step_after_seconds: 600
next: 0.20
rollback_triggers:
  p95_latency_ms: 1200
  error_pct: 0.5
```

kevin-oncall: Add an emergency kill-switch path please — I can flip it and verify drains. Keep #deploy-alerts live.

maya: deploy-bot — confirm you'll unpin service to canary and then shift traffic per plan, and echo when cohort ramps. Also verify smoke tests post-20% ramp.

deploy-bot: Confirmed. Actions at T0:
- unpin service -> canary
- set ff/llm-routing-v3 to 5%
- run baseline health checks (2m)
If health OK after 10m, shift to 20% and run smoke/embeddings_check. If any rollback_triggers tripped, auto-rollback will pin back to previous stable version. CI: all green.

jonathan: Short and clear — if p95 spikes >1200ms or 5xx rate jumps, we call rollback. Who runs manual rollback if needed? @sasha?

sasha: I'll handle manual rollback and pin to v3.3.9 if thresholds hit. Graceful drain command ready:
`/run scripts/drain-canary.sh ff/llm-routing-v3`

maya: One more ask — after the 20% ramp, run a short stability check on embeddings output (schema + vector magnitude diff) so we catch subtle regressions.

deploy-bot: Smoke test scheduled after 20% ramp: `smoke/embeddings_check`. Will post pass/fail and attach logs here.

kevin-oncall: I'll keep Grafana and traces open, alert routing to #deploy-alerts. Ping with :rotating_light: if manual rollback requested.

maya: Thanks team — proceeding unless anyone raises a hard block in the next 15m :thumbsup:

jonathan: :thumbsup:

sasha: :+1:
